backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the QuickRepair backend with user profile management (register, get, save, delete), feedback submission and retrieval, and role-based access control distinguishing admin and authenticated users.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that defines the stable actor state shape (feedbackStore, ratingStore, userStore, feedbackCounter) and provides a no-op migration function returning the old state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three implemented features (phone number in profile modal, emoji removal from booking button, ServiceCard routing to /booking page) to their source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated JSON summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each component, hook, and configuration file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, chart, and other UI color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the QuickRepair app including Google Search Console verification, LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema with service offerings and area coverage, and preconnect/dns-prefetch hints for ICP and Internet Identity endpoints.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up React Query, implements pathname-based routing to render AdminPage at /admin, BookingPage at /booking, or the main site with lazily loaded below-fold sections elsewhere.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the 'About Us' section with a text description of QuickRepair and a 2x2 grid of highlight cards (response time, verified pros, pricing, coverage) using a fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Implements a password-protected admin panel with login form, and tabs for managing users and feedback (view, delete) fetched via custom query hooks, plus a services overview display.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormSecti: Renders an online booking form that submits via FormSubmit to an email address, collecting name, phone, and service details with a dark-themed styled layout.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Displays a contact section with clickable phone, email, and WhatsApp cards, working hours info, a service areas list, and an embedded Google Map.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Renders an accordion-style FAQ section with nine questions about QuickRepair's services, pricing, and policies, toggling answers open/closed with animated expand/collapse.
Displays a feedback/reviews section with sample and live reviews fetched from the backend, star ratings, and a form to submit new feedback using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Renders a fixed floating call button linking to a phone number with a gradient style and 'Call Now' label.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Renders a fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with logo, navigation links, a booking button, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders the sticky site header with logo, navigation, Internet Identity login/logout, profile dropdown, and a profile setup modal triggered when no profile exists.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Renders the full-screen hero section with animated headline, tagline, CTA buttons, and trust-indicator badges for the QuickRepair service.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Displays a three-step 'How It Works' process (book, arrival, resolution) with icons, connector lines, and a fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: A slide-in mobile navigation drawer with smooth-scroll nav links, an active section indicator via useScrollSpy, a 'Book Online' CTA button, and a footer with a phone number.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: A full-screen semi-transparent backdrop overlay component used to dim content behind the mobile navigation drawer, toggled via isOpen prop.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: A modal form for collecting user profile details (name, phone, service area) that validates input and submits via the useRegisterUser mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: A card component displaying a single repair service with its icon, description, starting price, and a 'Book Online' button that navigates to /booking.
A page section that renders a grid of ServiceCard components for all offered repair services, with a fade-in animation and a scroll-to-booking CTA button.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: A horizontal stats bar displaying three trust indicators (happy customers, response time, star rating) with icons and a fade-in scroll animation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: A custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element scrolls into view, enabling CSS fade-in animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating feedback data (getAllFeedback, averageRating, feedbackCount, addFeedback) and user profile data (getMyProfile, registerUser, isCallerAdmin), with a delayed-ready pattern to defer queries until after initial paint.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom hook that tracks which section is currently in view by comparing scroll position against section offsets, returning the active section ID.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for a dark theme with brand colors, and declares keyframe animations (fadeInUp, fadeIn, pulse-ring, slideInRight) along with utility classes for scroll-triggered transitions and gradient text.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: A standalone booking page with a sticky header and a form (submitted via formsubmit.co) that collects user details for service booking, including hidden fields for email subject, template, and redirect URL.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean sensitive parameters from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom brand/surface colors, Inter/Poppins fonts, card/glow box shadows, border radius tokens, and animation keyframes; includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the QuickRepair project state including existing features (phone collection, booking form fixes, routing) and a pending admin panel enhancement request (AR-4) to display full user profiles and bookings.
